module.purpose: Defines the public barrel API for the commenting package by re-exporting presentational commenting components, canvas-integrated commenting tools, hooks, state, mutations, and types, then registering the library with tldraw.
module.summary: This entry module is a barrel that consolidates the commenting package's public surface. It separates tldraw-independent presentation components from the canvas-coupled commenting layer, exposing UI elements, mention and reaction functionality, comment storage and mutations, hooks, sidebar controls, state utilities, and configuration types. Its only executable behavior is registering the library metadata through the global tldraw runtime.
module.businessContext: Supports collaborative commenting and discussion workflows in the tldraw canvas product. If this barrel or registration fails, consumers lose access to commenting APIs or library integration.

edgeCases.inputShape: Missing or undefined globalThis.TLDRAW_LIBRARY_NAME, globalThis.TLDRAW_LIBRARY_VERSION, or globalThis.TLDRAW_LIBRARY_MODULES
edgeCases.behavior: The values are passed directly to the registration function without validation or fallback.

edgeCases.inputShape: Module imported in an environment without the expected tldraw runtime registration support
edgeCases.behavior: Registration is still invoked during module evaluation and any resulting error propagates.

invariants.description: All public re-exports are established before library metadata registration executes.
Registration receives the three properties read from globalThis, without local fallback values.

assumptions.description: The runtime supplies the expected TLDRAW library metadata properties on globalThis.
The registration utility is available and safe to call during module initialization.
Consumers resolve the re-exported symbols from this package entry point rather than private source modules.

ambiguities.question: What concrete runtime behavior does registerTldrawLibraryVersion perform with the supplied global metadata?
Which re-exported symbols are runtime values versus type-only declarations after compilation?

concurrencyModel.notes: The module performs synchronous re-exports and one synchronous registration call during evaluation.
